```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(here::here("R", "00_setup.R"))
```

This analysis includes the **Objective 1B** samples from the **VaMonos** project, ran on 01/07/2026

Samples were thawed, counted and divided into those for the single cell CITE-Seq experiment and flow cytometry staining, the phenotyping monocyte panel was divided between panel A and panel B, which include the following markers:
  
  **Backbone:** LiveDead stain, Dump channel (CD3, CD19, CD335), CD14, CD16, TLR2, Slan, CX3CR1, CCR2 
  
  **Panel A:** CD89, CD32, CD64, FcER1a, CD35, CD11b, S100A8, CD163, CD36, HLA-DR, BAFF
  
  **Panel B:** CCR1, CXCR4, CD11b_activation_epitope, PD-1, PD-L1, CD40, CD86, TLR4, CD54, CD62L


After unmixing both panels in FACSChorus, fcs files were exported and gating was done in this order:

Time -> Singlets (Radial moment vs Eccentricity) -> Live cells -> TLR2+, Dump channel- 

This last TLR2+ pop was exported as new fcs files and are what will be processed in this code

It is important to know that the newly exported fcs files, look different flowjo if using the Software unmixed parameters

(because it's like double unmixing)

# Data loading and transformation

First, we check the scale of the parameters. There is a waveformpresent parameter that is not in all fcs files

So we remove it from the fcs files to be able to merge them all, and create new modified fcs files that are in data/raw/FCS_without_WaveformPresent

```{r, include=FALSE}

#Load one of the fcs files to check if the parameters are unmixed 
#This might not work on fcs files from other cytometers because the parameter names might be different
#If it has an unmixing matrix applied it means the files are unmixed

ff <- read.FCS(
  file.path(paths$raw, "PA_TLR2+_A01-1.fcs"),
  truncate_max_range = FALSE
)

ff@description[["BDSPECTRAL UNMIXED"]]
ff@description[["BDSPECTRAL MATRIX NAME"]]

# Identify and create lists of the unmixed FCS files for each panel

fcs_files_PA <- list.files(paths$raw, pattern = "PA", full.names = TRUE)
fcs_files_PB <- list.files(paths$raw, pattern = "PB", full.names = TRUE)

# since we realized we could not load all the fcs files into a flowset due to the
# different number of parameters, we create a function to remove the extra parameter from all the fcs files
# the function first checks if the fixed fcs files are already in the folder to not create them again

new_fcs_files_dir <- file.path("data", "raw", "FCS_without_WaveformPresent_2")
dir.create(new_fcs_files_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Function to remove WaveformPresent and save corrected FCS files

fix_fcs_files <- function(fcs_files, output_dir) {

  fixed_files <- file.path(output_dir, basename(fcs_files))

  for (i in seq_along(fcs_files)) {
  
    if (file.exists(fixed_files[i])) {
      message("Already processed: ", basename(fcs_files[i]))
      next
    }

    ff <- read.FCS(
      fcs_files[i],
      transformation = FALSE,
      truncate_max_range = FALSE
    )

    channels <- colnames(exprs(ff))

    if ("WaveformPresent" %in% channels) {
      ff <- ff[, channels != "WaveformPresent"]

      message("Removed WaveformPresent from: ",
              basename(fcs_files[i]))
    } else {
      message("Parameter not present: ",
              basename(fcs_files[i]))
    }

    write.FCS(ff, filename = fixed_files[i])
  }

  return(fixed_files)
}

fcs_files_PA_fixed <- fix_fcs_files(fcs_files_PA, new_fcs_files_dir)
fcs_files_PB_fixed <- fix_fcs_files(fcs_files_PB, new_fcs_files_dir)

#when loading fcs files, it's important to set the truncation and transformation arguments to FALSE, or the functions apply their own transformations

PA_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(
  fcs_files_PA_fixed,
  truncate_max_range = FALSE,
  transformation = FALSE
)

PA_GatingSet <- GatingSet(PA_cytoset)

PB_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(
  fcs_files_PB_fixed,
  truncate_max_range = FALSE,
  transformation = FALSE
)

PB_GatingSet <- GatingSet(PB_cytoset)

```

Add necessary study metadata to the fcs files

```{r}

#create a structure for the metadata dataframe from the information stored in the fcs file name (ID, Panel)

metadataPA <- data.frame(
  name = basename(fcs_files_PA_fixed),
  ID = sub(".*-([0-9]{1,2})\\.fcs$", "\\1",
           basename(fcs_files_PA_fixed)),
  panel = substr(basename(fcs_files_PA_fixed), 1, 2),
  row.names = basename(fcs_files_PA_fixed)
)

metadataPB <- data.frame(
  name = basename(fcs_files_PB_fixed),
  ID = sub(".*-([0-9]{1,2})\\.fcs$", "\\1",
           basename(fcs_files_PB_fixed)),
  panel = substr(basename(fcs_files_PB_fixed), 1, 2),
  row.names = basename(fcs_files_PB_fixed)
)

#read dataframe with necessary information (it needs to contain a matching column with the fcs files in order to merge, in this case the ID column)

obj1_file_path<-file.path(paths$metadata,"20261021_vamonos_obj1_phenotyping_data.xlsx")

obj1_file_data<- readxl::read_xlsx(obj1_file_path)

UpdatedMetadata_PA <- merge(metadataPA, obj1_file_data, by= "ID", all.x= TRUE)
UpdatedMetadata_PB <- merge(metadataPB, obj1_file_data, by= "ID", all.x= TRUE)

#to update the metadata stored in the fcs files, we need to have the fcs file name as the rownames of the metadata

rownames(UpdatedMetadata_PA) <- UpdatedMetadata_PA$name
rownames(UpdatedMetadata_PB) <- UpdatedMetadata_PB$name

pData(PA_GatingSet) <- UpdatedMetadata_PA
pData(PB_GatingSet) <- UpdatedMetadata_PB
pData(PA_GatingSet)
pData(PB_GatingSet)

```

After the metadata, check the parameters and marker names, and how do they look untransformed.
We apply the biexponential transformation

```{r}

#colnames(PA_GatingSet)
#markernames(PA_GatingSet)

#we check if the samples have any transformation applied, by the gh_get_transformations function and also visually by plotting some of the parameters

gh_get_transformations(PA_GatingSet[[1]])

ggcyto(PA_GatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="FSC-A", y="SSC (Violet)-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

ggcyto(PA_GatingSet[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="CD14-A", y="CD16-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

#obtain a list of the fluorochrome channels that we are interested in 

fluor_channels_PA <- colnames(PA_GatingSet)[!grepl("FSC|SSC|Time|Imaging|Violet|Intensity|Moment|Dump channel FITC|Saturated|Sorted|Row|Column|Img|)-A|)-H|Phase|SpectralEvent|MergedTrigger", colnames(PA_GatingSet))]

#estimate the necessary logicle(biexponential) transformations to apply to each parameter and apply them to the samples
#multiple samples can be used for this estimation, if the result is not satisfactory

tf_PA<- estimateLogicle(PA_GatingSet[[1]], fluor_channels_PA)

PA_GatingSet_t<- transform(PA_GatingSet, tf_PA)

ggcyto(PA_GatingSet_t[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BV421-A", y="BV570-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

fluor_channels_PB <- colnames(PB_GatingSet)[!grepl("FSC|SSC|Time|Imaging|Violet|Intensity|Moment|Dump channel FITC|Saturated|Sorted|Row|Column|Img|)-A|)-H|Phase|SpectralEvent|MergedTrigger", colnames(PB_GatingSet))]

tf_PB<- estimateLogicle(PB_GatingSet[[1]], fluor_channels_PB)

PB_GatingSet_t<- transform(PB_GatingSet, tf_PB)

ggcyto(PB_GatingSet_t[1], subset="root",
 aes(x="BV421-A", y="BV570-A")) + geom_hex(bins=100)

store_fcs_PA<- file.path("data", "after QC", "Panel A")
store_fcs_PB<- file.path("data", "after QC", "Panel B")

save_gs(PA_GatingSet_t, store_fcs_PA)
save_gs(PB_GatingSet_t, store_fcs_PB)

```
